chunks.rationale: Start with electron/test/ask-runner.test.js. That is the contract the issue asked for: an ask thread answers without materializing a worktree, without tripping the daily budget, and without recording spend. Then electron/test/ask.test.js (prompt pack + fm-before-print) and electron/test/ask-mode.test.js (start/stop/fork). Renderer: test/askCard.test.tsx and the new case in test/orchestratorDefault.test.tsx (ask wins over defaultWorktree/defaultOrchestrate).
risks: ask-runner injects askComplete/searchMemory, so it does not prove fm or a real CLI print-mode works on this machine.
The budget assertion only checks getSpendToday(); a future recordUsage-without-recordSpend leak would still be green.

chunks.rationale: Then electron/runner.js startAskRun and the startRun intercept (ask before orch commands, budget, and materializePendingWorktree). This is the fail-closed gate: if it is skipped, Ask becomes a normal agent run in the checkout. Read stopRun/stopAll kind===ask next so Stop still kills the print child.
risks: The intercept is a boolean on thread.ask. A missed persist (store dropping unknown fields) would silently fall through to a full agent.

startAskRun returns {runId} and completes in a detached async IIFE. A throw after active.set but before the IIFE is attached cannot happen, but a stop that races the IIFE relies on entry.stopping + active identity.
notifyRunTerminal is deliberately skipped so Ask never checkpoints or records spend. finishSuccessfulTurn still drains queued follow-ups — confirm that is wanted.

chunks.rationale: electron/ask.js is the pure pack (buildAskPrompt, completeAsk, retrievalFallback). services.js startAsk/stopAsk/fork copy + forkWorkerThread skipping pendingWorktree. ipc.js create: ask wins over worktree and orchestrate. Then the UI chain: Sidebar caret 'New ask thread', ThreadView AskCard + header button, Composer hiding permission/Build/Best-of-N/attach.
risks: stopAsk({worktree:true}) arms pendingWorktree only when canHostWorktree (local + .git). Start work on a non-git folder is a silent plain thread.
Ask on a thread that already has worktreePath leaves the directory on disk unused; we do not delete it.
Composer still allows slash commands to be typed; they become the question because the ask intercept is first. /handoff on an Ask thread will not fan out.
No live Electron click-through of the caret or Ask card; verification is unit/renderer tests plus tsc --noEmit.
Print-mode fallback still uses the user's provider CLI (claude -p --max-turns 1). That is cheap and no-tools, but it is not zero subscription usage. fm is the free path.
Memory search fails closed (empty pack) if the memory server is down; the answer then comes from the code index alone.
